# Vendored wheels

`libpff_python-20231205-cp311-cp311-win_amd64.whl` is a prebuilt Windows
build of **libpff-python** (pypff) from the libyal project, release
20231205, provided for machines without C++ build tools.

- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later. See
  `LGPL-3.0.txt` and `GPL-3.0.txt` in this directory (the LGPL
  supplements the GPL).
- Corresponding source: https://github.com/libyal/libpff (tag 20231205),
  also published on PyPI as the `libpff-python` 20231205 source
  distribution.
- The wheel is installed as a separate package and can be replaced with
  any compatible build (`pip install libpff-python`).
